name: Mirage
description: The Mitsubishi Mirage is a compact and fuel-efficient hatchback designed for practical city driving and everyday convenience. With its sleek exterior styling, compact size, and comfortable interior, the Mirage is ideal for first-time car owners, students, and daily commuters.
tagline: Smart, Stylish, and Fuel-Efficient for Everyday Drives.

name: L300
tagline: Built Tough for Every Business Journey.

name: 2023 Creta
description: The Hyundai Creta is a stylish and versatile compact SUV designed for modern city driving and family adventures. Featuring a bold exterior design, premium interior comfort, and advanced technology features, the Creta delivers a refined and enjoyable driving experience.

name: 2024 Navara Calibre-X 4×2
description: The Nissan Navara Calibre-X 4×2 is a premium pickup truck that combines rugged performance, modern technology, and everyday comfort. Designed for both urban driving and heavy-duty tasks, the Navara Calibre-X offers a bold exterior design, refined interior, and reliable capability for work and adventure.

name: Hiace Commuter Deluxe
description: The Toyota Hiace Commuter Deluxe is a spacious and dependable passenger van designed for business, transport services, and family travel. Known for its durability, comfort, and strong performance, the Hiace Commuter Deluxe offers excellent passenger capacity combined with Toyota’s trusted reliability.
tagline: Built for Every Journey. Designed for Every Passenger.

name: 2024 City Sensing
description: The Honda City is a stylish and fuel-efficient sedan designed for modern city driving and everyday comfort. Featuring a sleek exterior design, premium interior finishes, and advanced Honda SENSING safety technology, the City delivers a smart and confident driving experience for both new and experienced drivers.
tagline: Advanced Safety and Premium Comfort in Every Drive.

name: 2023 Strada Athlete 4×4
description: The Mitsubishi Strada Athlete 4×4 is a premium pickup truck built for power, durability, and adventure. Designed with a bold and aggressive exterior, the Strada Athlete combines rugged off-road capability with modern comfort and advanced technology, making it ideal for both work and lifestyle use.
tagline: Conquer Every Road with Power and Style.

name: 2023 Stargazer GL
description: The Hyundai Stargazer GL is a modern and family-friendly MPV designed for comfort, space, and everyday practicality. With its futuristic exterior styling, spacious 7-seater cabin, and advanced technology features, the Stargazer GL delivers a smooth and enjoyable driving experience for both city and long-distance travel.
tagline: Future-Ready Comfort for the Modern Family.

name: 2023 MG ZS
description: The MG ZS is a stylish and modern compact SUV built for comfort, practicality, and everyday driving. Featuring a sleek exterior design, spacious interior, and advanced technology features, the MG ZS offers a premium driving experience at an affordable price point.
tagline: Style, Comfort, and Smart Driving in One SUV.

name: 2023 D-MAX 4×2
description: The Isuzu D-MAX 4×2 is a powerful and dependable pickup truck designed for both work and everyday driving. Equipped with a fuel-efficient yet durable diesel engine, the D-MAX delivers strong performance, excellent hauling capability, and impressive reliability for long-term use.
tagline: Built for Tough Roads and Everyday Reliability.

name: 2022 FB Body
description: The Mitsubishi FB Body is a durable and versatile utility vehicle built for both business and transport operations. Known for its reliable diesel engine, strong chassis, and spacious rear body configuration, the FB Body is commonly used for passenger transport, logistics, delivery services, and commercial fleet operations.
tagline: Reliable Utility Built for Everyday Operations.

name: 2019 Honda Mobilio
description: The Honda Mobilio is a stylish and practical 7-seater MPV designed for families and daily city driving. It features a sporty exterior, spacious cabin, flexible seating arrangement, and fuel-efficient performance powered by a 1.5L i-VTEC engine paired with either a manual or CVT transmission.
tagline: Spacious Comfort for Every Family Journey.

name: Vios
description: The Toyota Vios is a stylish and fuel-efficient sedan built for everyday driving, combining practicality, comfort, and Toyota’s trusted reliability. Known as one of the most popular sedans in the Philippines, the Vios is perfect for city commuting, family use, and first-time car owners.

features.title: Dependable Design
features.text: The Philippines' best-selling staple - finessed exterior design that's agile on the street, with the same reliable grip and steering that you can always trust.

features.title: Easy Convenience
features.text: Look no further. Ergonomically designed to deliver all you need for your everyday ease and convenience.

features.title: Efficient Performance
features.text: Strength and reliability harmonize to deliver uncompromised driving experience, all from a renowned efficient sedan.

features.title: Comfort in an All-In-One
features.text: The Vios gives you the comfort you need for all your drives, from cushioned seats to smooth turns.

features.title: Guaranteed Safety
features.text: Safety is comfort. With the Vios, safety is the top of mind to ensure peace of mind at every turn.

features.title: Experience Lasting Power & Strength
features.text: Find the perfect balance of power and charm in a car

tagline: Elegant, fuel-efficient, and built for everyday driving comfort.
